cohort: 100 parous women aged 20-40 presenting with abnormal uterine bleeding (AUB) to a gynecology clinic in Indore, India, excluding those with severe anemia, pregnancy, pelvic inflammatory disease, systemic causes of bleeding, vaginal and cervical causes of bleeding, thyroid disorder, coagulation disorder, uncontrolled diabetes mellitus or hypertension.
finding: Hysteroscopy was superior to transvaginal sonography in evaluating abnormal uterine bleeding.
